ideas.title: Following the Money in Food Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails of food fraud cases, including the Partners in Nutrition case.
questions: How much money was involved in the Partners in Nutrition case?
What other companies or individuals were involved in the fraud?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to uncover a larger network of food fraud and identify key players. This story has the potential to expose a significant scandal and bring about justice for those affected.
